Name: Flooded Cave
Author: tikamin557
Description:
Access to the cave is available from backwoods.
At the beginning of the game, the cave is blocked by rocks.
If you add a basement to your house, Robin will help you get rid of the rocks.

[size=5][color=#00ff00]MAP[/color] - [color=#6d9eeb]Flooded Cave[/color][/size]
Casks function inside caves.
The types of fish you can catch are determined by a unique table, allowing you to catch a variety of fish.
Stones, boulders, and weeds can spawn inside the cave every day.
In the upper left area, ore is generated according to the player's mining level.
You can grow crops in all seasons in dirt tiles.
Fruit trees can only be planted in dirt tiles and bear fruit regardless of the season.
(If you want to plant fruit trees on stone tiles as well, disable "Restrict Fruit Tree Planting" in the ModConfig settings of "(Code) Flooded Cave".)
Furthermore, when planting fruit trees, they won't be hindered by nearby weeds, stones, or flooring as they grow.

[size=5][color=#00ff00]MAP[/color] - [color=#b45f06]Minecart Room[/color][/size]
It becomes available after meeting certain conditions.
Its location is in the upper left corner of the dirt area in Flooded Cave.
Minecart is installed and registered in the vanilla destination list.

[size=5][color=#00ff00]MAP[/color] - [color=#ffff00]Break Room[/color][/size]
It becomes available after meeting certain conditions.
The location is at the top of Flooded Cave, accessible via a ladder on the left side of the river.
A Furnace2, Heavy Furnace3, and Big Stone Chest (supply storage) are already installed from the start.
(These facilities can be used by players, but they cannot be picked up as items using tools.)
You can arrange furniture just like in your own home, you can place a bed to sleep in, and you can even set up a mini jukebox to change the background music.
The wooden floor on the left can be freely changed by using flooring materials (furniture items).


[color=#ffff00][size=5]Mine Cart Open Conditions.[/size][/color]
[spoiler]Dates are after the 3rd day of summer of the first year. (Access to rail map)
Flooded Cave is open.(The basement of the house is finished)
The boiler room has been repaired.(Vanilla mine carts are available)
Friendship level of Lewis is 5 or higher.
Friendship level of Clint is 5 or higher.
Friendship level of Willy is 3 or higher.

If you meet all of these criteria, you will receive an mail and be able to use the mine cart.[/spoiler]
[color=#ffff00][size=5]Break Room Open Conditions. [/size][/color]
[spoiler]You have read the open mail for Minecart Room.
You have visited Minecart Room at least once.
Willy's affection level is 5 hearts or higher.

Once you meet the above conditions, you will receive an mail and gain access to the room.[/spoiler]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12089][size=5]Dam[/size][/url]﻿﻿[/*]
[/list]Simply installing both will not make them linkage.
The "Works with Other Mods" setting in ModConfig can be enabled to linkage.
The map will be edited so that you can move to the flooded cave from the lower right corner of the afforestation  (long vertical MAP behind the dam), which is the area of the Dam mod.
At the same time, the road from the back woods to flooded cave is blocked. It will be more immersive, but less accessible, so link as you wish.

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15041][size=5]Secret Woods Extra Area[/size][/url]﻿[/*]
[/list]Simply installing both will not make them linkage.
The "Works with Other Mods" setting in ModConfig can be enabled to linkage.
When linked, the entrance to Flooded Cave will appear in the weeds area of the "Secret Woods Extra Area" mod map (the map you access from the upper right corner of the Extra Area).
At the same time, the road from the back woods to flooded cave is blocked. It will be more immersive, but less accessible, so link as you wish.
